map.name: Quorra
map.trouble: Malgrith, a Master cast out of the Amber Tower, has woken the Undead in the old Ossuary north of Quorra.

bounty_offer.specifics: Grummet, the college gate porter, wants his best hat back from the Imps in the Amber Tower cellars.

offer.speaker: Grummet
offer.text:
Sorry, pal, the front gate's jammed shut! Only other road into the Amber Tower is round the side, down through the cellars where the Imps roost. And if you go that way, watch yourself down there! Them Imps snatched my best hat right off my head while I was dozing in the lodge!

Get it back for me and I'll hand over a cracking good spellbook.

reminder.speaker: Grummet
reminder.text: Got my hat yet? Them Imps won't give it up easy.

completion.speaker: Grummet
completion.text: My hat! I'd given it up for good! I owe you a big one. There's your spellbook, like I promised.

journal.text: Get Grummet's hat back from the Imps in the Amber Tower cellars.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Magister Fennick of the Observatory has lost his Star Lens to the Spiders' nest under the hill.

offer.speaker: Magister Fennick
offer.text:
Wretched crawling vermin! The Spiders came up from under the hill and they have already spun their filth over half the Observatory!

I am Magister Fennick. My Star Lens is gone from its stand. I suspect it was hauled off into the Spiders' nest below us.

Would you be willing to go down and bring it back up to me? I would gladly part with a treasure from my own cabinet in return.

refusal.speaker: Magister Fennick
refusal.text: A pity. I had thought better of you.

reminder.speaker: Magister Fennick
reminder.text: Is there any sign of my Lens? Oh my, those brutes may have broken it by now.

completion.speaker: Magister Fennick
completion.text:
My Star Lens! At last the heavens are mine again.

It seems the Spiders were nothing to you. You may have the makings of a scholar after all. Hmmm... Perhaps.

Take this Ankh from my cabinet. Carry it into the Ossuary when you go after Malgrith. We shall all need you alive before this is done.

after.speaker: Magister Fennick
after.text: Go carefully, and keep the Ankh about you.

journal.text: Recover Magister Fennick's Star Lens from the Spiders' nest.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Magister Fennick's Star Lens from the Spiders' nest.

two_givers.specifics: Nim Halfpenny sits in Proctor Hamble's cells and wants out; Bessaly, who runs the wagers on the student duels, needs him back for match night.

offer_a.speaker: Nim Halfpenny
offer_a.text: Hey, you! They call me Nim Halfpenny. Can you spring me from this cell? Do that, and I'll find you a way into the Sealed Library.

offer_b.speaker: Bessaly
offer_b.text:
Oh, blast it! Nim's locked up again?! I swear the boy gets caught on purpose so he can skip the work. Running wagers on the student duels is no picnic, you know. Tonight's the big match and nobody keeps the books like Nim does.

Here's the deal... Get Nim out of the cells and I'll throw in one of the steel shields from tonight's prize pile!

outcome_a.speaker: Nim Halfpenny
outcome_a.text: Free at last, thanks to you! Here's a bit of gold to show my thanks. Oh, right! This key opens the Sealed Library, like I said. Tread softly once you're inside. The old Masters don't take kindly to strangers poking around their shelves. Cheers!

outcome_b.speaker: Bessaly
outcome_b.text: Nim! What's the big idea, getting thrown in the cells on match night? Much obliged for springing him, stranger! One steel shield, just as I said. Best of luck with whatever it is you're after!

journal_a.text: Free Nim Halfpenny from Proctor Hamble's cells.

journal_b.text: Break Nim out of the cells and see Bessaly about the shield.

rescue.specifics: Proctor Hamble begs the player to clear the Sunken Archive and bring out the students trapped there.

plea.speaker: Proctor Hamble
plea.text:
Where have you been all this time!? Something dreadful has happened!

Ghosts and Giant Leeches have risen out of the flooded floors of the Sunken Archive. Brave students have perished down there for the sake of learning!

I implore you! Drive the creatures out of the Archive, bring my students back and you will be paid well.

With this key you can open the first of the locked reading rooms. The student inside knows where the rest are hiding.

I also have a potion for the Leeches' poison which you will surely need.

reminder.speaker: Proctor Hamble
reminder.text: Bring my students back up safe, and you'll not find me ungrateful.

found.speaker: Tamsin
found.text: Oh, at last, somebody came! Get me up the stairs, please!

completion.speaker: Proctor Hamble
completion.text:
What a hero you are! The Amber Tower is in your debt.

Dravik stopped in while you were down below with my students, asking after you. You'll find him at the Ferry Landing -- south of town.

But first, this gold is yours, as I said.

journal.text: Clear the Ghosts and Leeches from the Sunken Archive. Bring out the 4 trapped students.

main_opening.specifics: Orlo points the player to Archmage Thule in the Amber Tower, who sends him after Malgrith in the Ossuary.

herald.speaker: Orlo
herald.text: I thought heroes never needed directions. Try Archmage Thule at the top of the Amber Tower.

opening.speaker: Archmage Thule
opening.text:
Ah, lad, you've come -- and to Quorra in its darkest hour. The Amber Tower can do no more for itself.

Past the north gate lies the old Ossuary, where Malgrith, once a Master of this college, has woken the Undead. She knows you are coming. I must hold the wards here, and you must go at once!

Quorra has no one else.

journal.text: Seek out Malgrith, the outcast Master, in the old Ossuary.
